limitations: One port and one annual matched-month comparison cannot establish a global or nationwide trend. No alternative-port, cargo-composition or congestion control was available.
NBS index verified dated release links but supplied no selected activity levels. Its bounded publisher-restricted search returned unrelated domains; all returned hits were excluded.
Korea Customs index identifies a provisional September1–20 release; no trade cells were extracted and partial-month activity is not treated as a full month.
Taiwan MOF page provided an ebook listing, not measured current semiconductor or quantum data. Eurostat returned429 and was not retried.
No compatible China commodity imports, physical production, energy/property panel or customs price/volume decomposition was obtained.

This run uses reviewed limited extracts fetched in the September 22 investigation; no new publisher access or original raw-byte reread occurred. The September 23 cutoff denotes this analysis and verified repository availability, not a new publication vintage.
Prior own-domain report and numerical results were seen before analysis. This is exploratory reproducibility and reappraisal, not independent confirmation.
